note: Variants affecting the KDM2B CxxC domain are specifically reported to cause structural ocular malformations alongside cardiac and renal anomalies.

evidence.text: Screening in 706 families with developmental eye disorders found KDM2B CxxC domain variants associated with complex structural eye defects and variable cardiac and renal anomalies, accompanied by a distinctive DNA episignature.

source.title: Variants in the CxxC domain of the epigenetic regulator KDM2B support its role in developmental eye anomalies
source.quote: Both individuals exhibited complex structural eye defects, with neurodevelopmental, cardiac and renal anomalies variably present. These cases strengthen the association between KDM2B-CxxC variants and eye, kidney and heart malformations

numbers.metric: families screened with developmental eye disorders

evidence.text: Loss-of-function analysis in developing retinas demonstrated that knockout of KDM2B (Fbxl11) suppresses retinal progenitor cell proliferation, increases apoptosis, and results in microphthalmia.

source.title: The histone H3K36 demethylase Fbxl11 plays pivotal roles in the development of retinal late‐born cell types
source.quote: Fbxl11 knockout in developing retinas increased apoptosis, suppressed the proliferation of retinal progenitor cells, and resulted in microphthalmia.
